name: Menlo Park Fire District Explorer Post 109
what_you_do: Explorers learn basic firefighting skills from the district's firefighters at regular meetings. They see many kinds of fire jobs. They also help at events like the Menlo Fire 5K and a pancake breakfast.
who_can_apply: Ages 14 to 21. You must be in school with at least a 2.0 GPA and no failing grades, be in good physical condition (with exceptions), and should not have a criminal record. A parent or guardian must sign the application. The page does not list a residency rule.
pay_detail: Unpaid volunteer program. The page does not list any cost.
duration: Ongoing. The page says training happens at bi-monthly meetings and Explorers must attend all Explorer events.
deadline_text: No deadline or application window is posted.
how_to_apply: Fill out an application and have a parent or guardian sign it. The page does not link the form, so email Eric Mijangos at explorer109@menlofire.gov to ask for one. District office: 170 Middlefield Road, Menlo Park, 650-688-8400.
notes: You need reliable transportation, and you will be tested to show you learned the skills. The page says bi-monthly meetings but does not give days or times. Exploring is part of Learning for Life. The district's separate Fire Cadet program is not for high schoolers (it needs EMT and Firefighter I training).
